title: 甜味时光
description: Sweet Time is a restaurant simulation game where players need to play as a debt-laden protagonist to run a restaurant and pay off debts, and over the course of a year, you can expand your restaurant, renovate the layout, and recruit employees, with a variety of side stories and endings, which are up to you. Recruit employees, upgrade and allocate skill points reasonablyThere are dozens of employees in the game that can be recruited freely, rare employees bring their own skills, and there are many special employees to unlock. Reasonable training of employees is your greatest help! Free decoration layout, try different style typesUpgrade and expand your shop, a variety of decorations and furniture styles, there is always one for you. Foodie Kick RestaurantOnce a month, the gourmand kicks the restaurant and makes a dish that satisfies him! Food Festival CompetitionA quarterly food festival competition, run the restaurant reasonably, and strive to win the gold medal! Multiple recipes, collected by youThere are up to 76 recipes in the game, collect it!
description_short: "Sweet Time" is a restaurant simulation management game, players need to play the role of a debt-ridden protagonist to run a restaurant and pay off debts, in a year's time, you can expand the restaurant, renovate the layout and recruit employees, a variety of side plots and endings, you start.
